entries.c08a3c6c96442fdd: The company has set a medium-term management plan, 'Raito2027', and its basic policy is 'Technology × Trust × People, Toward Next-Generation Growth'. The company has four priority themes: building brand strength in disaster prevention and disaster mitigation and solving social issues; expanding its presence in specialized civil engineering in Japan and overseas; investing actively in growth fields and people; and growth investment and shareholder returns, and it targets consolidated revenue of ¥135 billion for fiscal 2027, the final year of the plan. Its medium-to-long-term vision, looking ahead to its 100th anniversary, is 'Contribute to the world through the power of people and technology toward a sustainable society'.
